name: Integration settings, AI inference and real Tailscale browser node

steps: Open the actual production build and create a local vault with the Device PIN form.
Enable Connections and On-device model through the Features switches.
Open Integrations at the former Local storage anchor and scroll Payments into the same viewport.
Open Integrations AI and record the actual controls and viewport.
Open Features AI and record the actual controls and viewport.
Open Tailscale connection settings and record its actual editable fields.
On the changed build, open the newly added BYO AI configuration.

ai: Configure native OpenAI Chat and Responses, then BYO Anthropic and Gemini against real HTTP sockets with custom API mount paths.
Test and save each protocol through authenticated inference, select the saved model in Features, cold reload and unlock with the PIN.
Reveal and hide its actual vault Token item, then send JSON and genuine SSE inference through the saved connection.
tailnet: Start pinned real Headscale, its embedded DERP, and a native Tailscale userspace peer with a real HTTP proof service.
Configure the browser through the Tailscale form and connect the actual emitted official SDK/WASM worker.
Verify real Noise control and DERP WebSocket traffic, authorization, and an actual GET to the native peer.
Lock, cold reload, unlock, read the vault-held private state and reconnect without another enrollment key.
Explicitly disconnect and forget the local node, then verify its vault credential was removed.

In a fresh installed PWA, verify the unapproved cache excludes all SDK assets, then approve Networking and await matching release/digest readiness before first SDK use. Stop the real app server, cold reload and PIN-unlock from the service worker, reconnect and GET the separate real peer.
limits: No hosted AI partner or Tailscale tenant account is claimed.
Headscale, DERP and native peer are real test infrastructure, not an application backend dependency.
The public official SDK fetch interface supports GET; mutation of tailnet services is not claimed.
